title: Environmental Window Discovery for Trait Associations
text: window_sizes defines length candidate period. example, window_sizes = 28 summarizes weather consecutive 28-day windows. step defines many days window moves next test. 28-day window step = 7, package tests: days 0-27; days 7-34; days 14-41; subsequent starts every seven days. smaller step gives finer temporal resolution generates tests requires computation. larger step faster gives coarser search. Multiple window sizes can tested together, example window_sizes = c(14, 28, 42).

title: Scan environmental windows for trait associations — scan_env_windows
text: object class `env_window_scan` containing: * `correlations`: test results every weather-trait-window combination; * `windows`: candidate window definitions; * `periods`: validated environment metadata; * `trait_means`: environment-level phenotype means; * `settings`: analysis settings. `x`, invisibly.

title: Scan environmental windows for trait associations — scan_env_windows
text: **Window size** number consecutive days summarized test. example, `window_sizes = 28` calculates one weather summary every 28-day candidate period. `window_sizes = c(14, 28, 42)` evaluates short, medium, long periods. **Step size** controlled `step` determines far window moves tests. 28-day window `step = 7`, first windows days 0-27, 7-34, 14-41, . smaller step provides finer temporal resolution creates tests takes longer. larger step faster may miss narrow response periods. independent unit environment environment-year. Genotypes replicates within environment increase number independent weather observations. Consequently, default analysis averages selected trait across rows within environment.

title: envwindowr 0.2.0
text: Added query_weather_data() retrieve historical daily weather Open-Meteo Archive API using environment coordinates season dates. Added write_envwindow_templates() create phenotype, environment, weather CSV templates. Added support season_start season_end environment columns without requiring explicit column-name arguments. Expanded help pages, examples, README instructions, real-data vignette. Updated simulated phenotypes include genotype_id environment metadata include coordinates optional altitude. Added explicit guidance window size, step size, environment independent analysis unit.
